criteria.channels: RGBA; exact pixel equality, no image resizing in comparisons
criteria.outside: Zero changed pixels outside the union of both registered eye bounds
criteria.doubleClosed: Exact full-image equality to the approved matching closed-eye state at center and all eight extrema
criteria.singleClosed: Zero changed pixels in the closed eye bounds plus its entire expression patch, against both approved state and candidate center

nearZero.note: Eight directions approaching zero for open and half states. Larger .001/.01 samples are measurements only; no artistic-quality assertion.
